philosophy: GrantThai lowers the entry barrier to research, not the standard of research.

Toledo connects lived experience with academic knowledge through translation — by people, and optionally with AI assistance — while evidence, methodology, and human expertise remain the gates to verifiable knowledge.
toledo_disclosure: Toledo here refers only to the conceptual framework. GrantThai contains no Toledo-registered equations and no proofs.
